io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks

Class MultiBlockMachine

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks.MultiBlockMachine
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ItemAttribute, NotPlaceable, Placeable, RecipeDisplayItem
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AbstractCraftingTable, AutomatedPanningMachine, Compressor, GrindStone, IndustrialMiner, Juicer, MakeshiftSmeltery, OreCrusher, OreWasher, PressureChamber, Smeltery, TableSaw

    public abstract class MultiBlockMachine
extends SlimefunItem
implements NotPlaceable, RecipeDisplayItem
    A MultiBlockMachine is a SlimefunItem that is built in the World. It holds recipes and a MultiBlock object which represents its structure.

      • autoCraft

        public boolean autoCraft(@Nonnull
                         org.bukkit.block.Block dispenser)
        Performs a single craft headlessly (no Player, no permission prompt, no MultiBlockCraftEvent) directly from a powered dispenser, ejecting the result out of the dispenser's front (or into an adjacent OutputChest). This backs the redstone auto-craft feature for every MultiBlockMachine whose structure contains a dispenser holding the recipe inputs.

        Matching is shapeless - the dispenser must contain every ingredient of some recipe in sufficient quantity - which covers both single-input machines (Ore Crusher, Compressor, ...) and multi-input ones (Smeltery). AbstractCraftingTable overrides this with its own shaped 3x3 matcher.

        Parameters:
        dispenser - The dispenser block that holds the recipe inputs
        Returns:
        Whether a craft was performed
